title: TaskEvent@1 envelope
description: One row of the Task log behind `af task` (ADR-0046), a contract distinct from RunEvent@1. A Task is one append-only sequence keyed by its ID; `sequence` is dense, gapless, and the only ordering authority. A Task event carries no inline payload: it names exactly one immutable CAS artifact, which must be durable before the row lands, and that artifact's `schema` marker is the payload contract.

event_type.description: Closed Task event vocabulary. Adding one is an explicit enum, schema, and admission change; the Rust `TaskEventType` must list exactly these.
